sections.description:
Clean product data is the cheapest automation you will ever buy. Orbital Foundry learned it the hard way.

Start with an attribute audit

Count the attributes that are empty, duplicated or written in three different units. See the audit guide and the attribute_set field.

  • completeness per category

  • consistency of units

  • one owner per attribute

Agree on one source of truth

AreaOwnerReview
AttributesCatalogue teamweekly
DescriptionsContent teammonthly

Keep the review short

A fifteen-minute review beats a quarterly clean-up.

Automate the boring parts

Only automate a step that is measurable, repeatable and fed with structured data.

faq_items.question: Where should we start?
faq_items.answer: With an audit of completeness and consistency.

faq_items.question: Will automation fix bad data?
faq_items.answer:
No. Clean the data first, then automate.

  • it scales whatever it is given
